headlines.title: Consortium of Advent, FedEx, A&R and PPF Completes Acquisition of InPost
headlines.summary: AMSTERDAM & LUXEMBOURG, November 20, 2026--Funds managed and/or advised by Advent International, L.P. and/or its affiliates ("Advent"), FCWB LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of FedEx Corporation ("FedEx"), A&R Investments Ltd. ("A&R") and PPF Group ("PPF"), together forming the Consortium, today announce the completion of the acquisition of InPost S.A. ("InPost" or the "Company"). InPost is now wholly-owned by the Consortium and has delisted from Euronext Amsterdam.

headlines.title: 343 Companies Report $28.5 Billion In Trump Tariff Refunds. Here's Where The Money Is Going.
headlines.summary: Major U.S. companies are recording billions in tariff recoveries following a Supreme Court ruling, with some reducing business costs and others returning payments to customers.

headlines.title: UPS Has Frozen Its Dividend at $1.64. Its 6% Yield Raises Questions
headlines.summary: UPS stopped raising its payout while buybacks vanished and debt climbed. Behind the CEO's reassurance sits a thin cash cushion, a rival with a stronger balance sheet, and one number in 2027 that could decide everything.

headlines.title: PostalAnnex Franchisees Expand Local Business Portfolio with Third Sacramento-Area Location in Roseville
headlines.summary: Annex Brands, Inc., one of the leading franchisors in the packing, shipping and office services industries, is excited to announce the opening of its newest PostalAnnex location in Roseville, CA to new owners Aarondeep Hira and Manraj Sangha. This new PostalAnnex is set to offer a wide range of essential shipping and office services to the local community, making it easier to provide more service to more people in more places.

description: FedEx Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, provides transportation, e-commerce, and business services in the United States and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Express U.S. Domestic and Express International. It provides e-commerce and digital solutions; dataworks; printing and shipping management, including digital printing, professional finishing, document creation, design solutions, direct mail, signs and graphics, custom-branded boxes, copying, computer rental, Wi-Fi, corporate print solutions, shredding, U.S. passport processing and renewal, and digital notarization; packing services, as well as packing supplies and boxes; document and business services; and retail access for package transportation. In addition, the company offers logistics services, air and ocean cargo transportation, specialty transportation, customs brokerage, trade management tools and data, and door-to-door solutions; and third party logistics and supply chain management solutions, such as inbound logistics, warehousing and distribution, fulfillment, contract packaging and product configuration, systems integration, returns process and disposition, test, repair, refurbishment, and product liquidation. Further, it provides sales, marketing, administrative, information technology, and back-office support services. FedEx Corporation was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Memphis, Tennessee.
